lines: Recorded, mixed, and mastered by us.
ffo: Kasabian, Idles, Sleaford Mods, and noise
bio: Since forming in March 2026, we’ve released two singles, one EP, and sold out our debut headliner during presale.
We’ve been in bands before, but now we’re back. We’re not holding back though. These songs are about our lives. Messy. But honest.

quotes.text: Brilliant… reminds me of the Skinner Brothers
Bucko sound like a band who belong in a sweaty, packed-out venue, where these songs could really come alive. 10/10
